title: On Holding the rail with both hands
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：hold　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hold 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the driver ① held the rail with both hands on the same day, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② holds the rail with both hands before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hold the rail with both hands at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ held the rail with both hands before — a line in the timetable for February 1963 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Holding the rail with both hands on the same day, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hold thirty people at a pinch before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hold thirty people at a pinch at once and never mention it again.

By 1976 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ holds thirty people at a pinch on the same day every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ held the rail with both hands again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hold the rail with both hands, my mother said in 1981, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody holds the rail with both hands before dawn again and somebody must hold the rail with both hands on the same day all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 握住（一般过去式 held the rail with both hands：1969 年司机头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 握住（一般现在 holds the rail with both hands：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 握住（不定式 to hold the rail with both hands：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 握住（过去完成时 had held the rail with both hands：1963 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 握住（动名词 holding the rail with both hands 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 容纳（hold thirty people at a pinch：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去容纳挤一挤也装得下三十人）
G. v. 容纳（hold thirty people at a pinch：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 握住（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 holds thirty people at a pinch，而母亲又一次 held the rail with both hands）

hold 意为“握住”，自那以后司机天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 holds。
hold 意为“握住”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯握住双手握住那道栏杆”，此处为不定式 to hold the rail with both hands。
hold 意为“握住”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1976 年之前就有人握住过，故用过去完成时 had held。

hold 意为“容纳”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去容纳挤一挤也装得下三十人”，should ever 之后用原形 hold thirty people at a pinch。
hold 意为“容纳”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻容纳挤一挤也装得下三十人（hold thirty people at a pinch at once），以后再也不要提起。
hold 意为“握住”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例容纳挤一挤也装得下三十人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 holds。
hold 意为“握住”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就握住双手握住那道栏杆，用一般过去式 held 叙述。
hold 意为“握住”，结尾那句是母亲 1981 年的话：要握住双手握住那道栏杆，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hold 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the driver held the rail with both hands on the same day, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver holds the rail with both hands before dawn whenever the station asks.
Holding the rail with both hands on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hold thirty people at a pinch before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station holds thirty people at a pinch on the same day every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother held the rail with both hands again, and the station remembered that half.
